notes:
r720's half of task 1306's MEM30-C residual split (hostap only; dev-180 has the other half: curl/lua/mosquitto/pureftpd/sel4/sqlite/valkey). Run 267 (main@c4c3ec58), after FP-reduction drivers 1233/1234/1235 landed -- per 1306's own note, adjudicated against this fresh baseline, not the earlier run 265. All 125 findings verdicted FP, zero TP. Read every full enclosing function (not just the flagged line) plus every relevant callee definition before judging; split into 4 source-reading passes (one for src/common/sae.c, three parallel passes for the rest) to keep each read thorough.

FOUR DISTINCT CONFIRMED ANALYZER BUGS, not corpus opinion (ADR-0005 misfires):

(1) bin_clear_free size-argument misfire, 34 findings (src/common/sae.c, vars prime_len x33 + password_len x1). bin_clear_free(void *bin, size_t len) frees param 0 (calls os_free(bin) internally) but MEM30-C's *_free name-heuristic fallback marks a call's LAST argument as freed (a convention that fits sqlite3DbFree(db,x)-style handle-first/target-last APIs but is backwards for this pointer-first/size-last one), so every call site's size_t len argument gets marked freed instead of the pointer. Filed as its own aurora_lint task, related to 1306.

(2) x = f(x) return-value reassignment not recognized as clearing freed-state, ~52 findings across src/ap/ieee802_11.c, src/common/dpp_backup.c, src/common/dpp_crypto.c, src/eap_peer/eap_fast.c, src/eap_peer/eap_teap.c, src/eap_server/eap_server_fast.c, src/eap_server/eap_server_teap.c, src/eap_server/eap_server_ttls.c, src/p2p/p2p.c, src/p2p/p2p_go_neg.c, src/p2p/p2p_group.c, src/pasn/pasn_responder.c, src/rsn_supp/wpa.c, src/wps/wps_attr_build.c, src/wps/wps_common.c, src/wps/wps_registrar.c. Confirmed callees that free their argument internally and return a fresh pointer or NULL: wpabuf_zeropad, wpabuf_concat, asn1_encaps, eap_teap_tlv_eap_payload, eap_ttls_avp_encapsulate, p2p_pasn_service_hash, wps_ie_encapsulate. Distinct from task 1234, which only fixed the &ptr output-parameter shape of this same underlying defect. This is the dominant FP driver in the batch by finding count. Filed as its own aurora_lint task (priority 2, likely the single highest-value MEM30-C fix given how common wpabuf's consume-and-rebuild convention is), related to 1306 and 1234.

(3) xml_node_get_text_free(ctx, val) frees its SECOND argument (val) but the tool attributes the free to the FIRST (ctx), 4 findings (src/utils/xml-utils.c). The inverse mis-selection from (1) -- here both arguments are pointer-typed, so it isn't simply 'picked the non-pointer arg'; looks like a FunctionSummary-resolution bug rather than the name-heuristic (whose own 'last argument' rule would get this one right). Filed as its own aurora_lint task, related to 1306.

(4) wpa_supplicant_deinit_iface's wpa_s flagged as freed by four helper calls (wpas_p2p_deinit_iface, wpas_nan_deinit, wpas_ctrl_radio_work_flush, radio_remove_interface) that verifiably do not free it -- the real os_free(wpa_s) is textually later in the same function (line 8215/8213). None of the four callee names match the FREE/DELETE name-heuristic keywords; mechanism not fully diagnosed. Filed as its own aurora_lint task, related to 1306.

Some findings also involve mutually-exclusive branches (class a, already partially handled by 1233) compounding with (2) above -- noted per-row where applicable, not double-counted as a fifth cause.

No TP in this batch. No known-but-unfixed FP driver was open for MEM30-C on hostap specifically before this batch (1233/1234/1235 were the drivers task 1306 gated on, and they landed on main before run 267); these four newly-found bugs were surfaced BY this batch, not pre-existing backlog items.
